name: NEFRA
subTagline: Rooted in tradition. Crafted for today.
description: NEFRA is a premium fast-casual Mediterranean restaurant inspired by the culinary traditions of ancient civilizations, coming soon to Sterling, Virginia.
_status_help: Set to "open" AND fill in orderUrl to switch every Order Online button on. While "coming-soon", buttons point visitors to the email signup instead.
_siteUrl_help: Full public address of the site, no trailing slash, e.g. https://www.nefrahouse.com. Needed for canonical links and sitemap.xml.
_logo_help: Path to the official NEFRA wordmark SVG, e.g. /assets/img/nefra-wordmark.svg. Until it is set, a temporary text stand-in is shown.
_forms_help: POST endpoints for a form service (Formspree, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Netlify Forms...). Leave blank until connected; the forms then explain they are not live yet.

hero._help: Optional. Set image (and alt) or a muted looping video. Without either, a styled placeholder is shown.
